title: A/B Comparison Evidence Design (BLOCK-001 Prep)
purpose: Design the A/B comparison between vanilla Codex and Factory-assisted workflow. This is DESIGN only — not execution, not evidence collection.

design.project: Same clean simple project, no deploy traces

run_a.name: RUN-A (vanilla baseline)
run_a.description: User + vanilla Codex builds the project with no Factory context

run_b.name: RUN-B (Factory-assisted)
run_b.description: User + Codex with Factory installed and Build Lite active

fairness_controls: Identical starting prompt for both runs
No hidden Factory context leaked to vanilla run
No pre-warmed context for Factory run
User does not manually inject Factory knowledge into vanilla run
evidence_scope: This design DOES NOT prove Factory superiority. It only enables a controlled comparison. Any claim of superiority requires the comparison to be executed and analyzed.
